title: Niagara Falls Small Group Tour
blurb:
Experience the best of Niagara Falls on the Canadian side with our fully live guided vehicle tour. View the falls up close with a scenic drive across many famous spots including Clifton Hill, Queen Victoria Park, Oakes Garden, Buddhist Temple, and more. Get amazing photo opportunities at the Spanish Aero Car. Enjoy a complimentary maple syrup tasting experience at the Maple Leaf Place.

You can upgrade and customize your tour by adding top attractions such as the Boat Cruise, Skylon Tower, Journey Behind the Falls, and Niagara Takes Flight 4D Experience. 

Unlike crowded bus tours, this is a small group tour which offers comfort and personalized experiences.

Hotel pickup and drop off included!

*Cruise will be replaced by the Flying 4D Theatre attraction (seasonal)
